text:
maria: Quick sync — product roadmap gating for Q3 feature set. Need alignment on infra/security/runtime for customer-driven private deploys. Product target: MVP in ~8 weeks. Key asks: prewarm support for low p99 latency, per-tenant reserved slots (soft quota), HSM/KMS integration timeline. Who volunteers to own cross-team next steps?
ashley: Can you share acceptance criteria? e.g., latency targets, SLO, and what 'reserved slots' means in practice.
kevin: From runtime: prewarm concept is OK. We need model warm snapshots + prefix KV cache. Est effort: 3w to prototype, 2w to harden. Risks: multi-tenant cache eviction edgecases.
sam: Infra: reserved slots = allocation of GPUs to a tenant with soft preemption. Current cluster capacity tight in region-us-west2. We can offer 10 reserved slots immediately, scaling to 25 with node add (~4w).
ashley: Security: HSM/KMS integration must be in place before private pilot. ETA if infra can allocate nodes? Also audit logs + key rotation policy required.
kevin: If we prototype prewarm using serialized KV snapshots, HSM push isn't a blocker for the runtime prototype. But final rollout needs KMS to decrypt tenant keys at boot. Mini pseudocode:\n```\nload_kv_snapshot();\ninit_kv_cache();\nrestore_prefix_state();\n```\nmaria: OK — proposal: 1) Prototype runtime prewarm (kevin) 2) Infra to reserve 10 slots for pilot (sam) 3) Security to scope HSM/KMS delta and list minimal requirements (ashley) 4) Product to lock acceptance tests (maria).
Can we get owners + rough dates?
kevin: Owner: runtime prewarm prototype — kevin. ETA: 3w (by May 1). Will open a PR with benchmark numbers and a small harness.
sam: Owner: infra reservation — sam. ETA: 1w to carve 10 slots (by Apr 10) if no capacity reorg. For >10 need node add (4w). I'll post capacity plan.
ashley: Owner: security scoping — ashley. ETA: 1w to produce HSM/KMS checklist + audit reqs. Will flag any compliance blockers.
maria: Great. Let's do a short 30-min handshake on Mon 11am PT to sync these owners and finalize roll criteria. Agenda: 1) Acceptance tests 2) Prewarm acceptance 3) Slot sizing 4) KMS path + rollback. Add any agenda items here.
kevin: +1. I'll bring the perf numbers we want to hit: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms for warm prefetched requests.
sam: Adding infra constraints: node lead time, capacity, and a fallback routing policy to hosted models if slots saturated.
ashley: Also add "audit log retention" to agenda.
devops-bot: Scheduled meeting created: "Roadmap gating handshake" Mon 11:00 PT — invite sent to @maria @ashley @kevin @sam. :calendar:
maria: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap ticket with owners and dates. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
